# The exit-code taxonomy: staleness and unreachability are never conflated.
# 0 = fresh, 1 = stale, 2 = network/auth/config — pinned per case.

fulcrum sync
fulcrum status

# Bad auth is a config problem: exit 2, never offline mode.
env FULCRUM_API_TOKEN=wrong
fulcrum -code 2 status
grep 'unauthorized' last-stderr.txt
env FULCRUM_API_TOKEN=corpus-token

# Unreachable server: exit 2, last-known rows still render, reachable=false.
env SAVED_URL=$FULCRUM_URL
env FULCRUM_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1
fulcrum -code 2 status
grep 'offline' last-stderr.txt
grep 'synced' last-stdout.txt
fulcrum -code 2 status --json
grep '"reachable": false' last-stdout.txt
grep '"state": "synced"' last-stdout.txt
env FULCRUM_URL=$SAVED_URL
fulcrum status

# No server configured at all: exit 2 with the fix spelled out.
env FULCRUM_URL=
fulcrum -code 2 status
grep 'no server configured' last-stderr.txt
